english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a suggestion or the act of putting one forward.
This is the all-purpose noun for a helpful recommendation about what someone should do.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a general plan, recommendation, or set of proposed terms.
This is the all-purpose choice for advice or a suggestion about what to do.
Use 建議 as the all-purpose everyday word for advice or guidance.
This is the all-purpose choice for an idea or plan put forward for consideration.

examples.english: I have a suggestion for you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 go3 gin3 ji5 bei2 nei5

examples.english: I want to give you some advice: don’t go to bed so late.
examples.traditional: 我想畀你一個建議，唔好咁夜先瞓。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 bei2 nei5 jat1 go3 gin3 ji5 m4 hou2 gam3 je6 sin1 fan3

examples.english: This proposal is quite practical; let's give it a try.
examples.traditional: 呢個建議幾實際，大家不如試吓。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gin3 ji5 gei2 sat6 zai3 daai6 gaa1 bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5

examples.english: My recommendation is that you leave home earlier tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我嘅建議係你聽日早啲出門口。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 gin3 ji5 hai6 nei5 ting1 jat6 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2

examples.english: I want to hear your counsel on this matter.
examples.traditional: 我想聽吓你對呢件事嘅建議。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 deoi3 ne1 gin6 si6 ge3 gin3 ji5

examples.english: We put forward a proposition for everyone to consider.
examples.traditional: 我哋提出咗一個建議，等大家一齊諗吓。
